title: Enums with associated values
summary: Represent mutually exclusive states with an enum and bind each case payload in an exhaustive switch.
triggers: one state has different data depending on its case
prompts: Describe a download without separate flags for waiting, progress, failure and completion.
invariant: Exactly one download state and its matching payload are active.
mantra: One case, one payload, one exhaustive switch.
pitfalls: Handle every case instead of using a default that hides future additions.
Associated values belong to an individual enum instance.
